Any strongly differentiable column on a fixed Krein carrier with bounded pairing would make its Gram differentiable, so I'(0+)=-infinity is an obstruction. The divided germ D=(I-I(0))/r has finite scale cocycle D(cr)-D(r)->log(c)/4. On R=-log r, translation gives -a/4; linearize it on span{1,s} inside S'(R_s), not L2(R_s).
